verdict.rationale: Codegen's own Slack app lets agents ask for clarification and report progress to the team, and agents can present a structured plan of implementation steps, which gives a thin channel for human input on agent decisions. Nothing documents an explicit approval gate, mobile access, or agents continuing other work while an approval is pending; the resume-paused-run API is a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented approval/sign-off workflow for key decisions, mobile/phone approval experience, evidence that agents keep working while awaiting approval, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can approve key agent decisions from my phone while agents continue working

citations.quote: Send notifications, ask for clarification, report progress, and interact directly with your team in Slack channels.
Agents will present a structured plan showing each implementation step
Add the Codegen Slack App to communicate with the agent directly in your workspace.
